title: Pressure-fed engine
description: The simplest liquid rocket cycle: high-pressure gas pushes the propellants out of the tanks and into the chamber. No pumps.

reference.engine: Aerojet AJ10-190 (Space Shuttle Orbital Maneuvering Engine)

published.cooling: fuel regenerative chamber, radiation-cooled nozzle extension

derived.note: throat from exit diameter and expansion ratio; chamber, injector, head and feed layout are representative, not from drawings

flow_model.note: Streak speed follows local flow speed on a compressed scale: display speed = 0.22 * v^0.32 (m/s).

liquids_ms.note: nominal values, not from engine data

parts.title: Thrust mount
parts.description: Bolts the engine to the vehicle and carries the thrust load into the structure.

parts.title: Gimbal joint
parts.description: Two-axis universal joint. Lets the whole engine swivel a few degrees so the thrust vector can steer the vehicle.

parts.title: Thrust adapter
parts.description: Short cone that transfers thrust from the injector head up into the gimbal.

parts.title: Injector bolts
parts.description: Clamp the dome, injector plate and chamber flange into one sealed stack.

parts.title: Oxidizer dome
parts.description: Manifold that spreads incoming oxidizer evenly across the back of the injector plate.

parts.title: Injector plate
parts.description: Sprays fuel and oxidizer through many small orifices so the streams collide, atomise and mix. The two propellants ignite on contact.

parts.title: Chamber liner
parts.description: Inner wall of the combustion chamber. Fuel runs up the channels milled into its outside and carries the heat away before it is burned. This is regenerative cooling.

parts.title: Chamber jacket
parts.description: Outer shell that closes the coolant channels and holds the chamber pressure.

parts.title: Fuel inlet manifold
parts.description: Ring at the aft end of the chamber. Feeds fuel into every coolant channel at once.

parts.title: Nozzle joint bolts
parts.description: Fasten the nozzle extension to the chamber exit flange.

parts.title: Nozzle extension
parts.description: Thin bell that expands the exhaust to high speed. It has no coolant: it glows hot and radiates the heat to space.

parts.title: Fuel valve
parts.description: Opens to start the fuel flow. Start, stop and restart are just valve commands.

parts.title: Oxidizer valve
parts.description: Opens to start the oxidizer flow. Start, stop and restart are just valve commands.

parts.title: Fuel inlet line
parts.description: Carries fuel from the valve down to the manifold at the aft end of the chamber.

parts.title: Oxidizer inlet line
parts.description: Carries oxidizer from the valve into the dome.

parts.title: Pitch actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine about one gimbal axis.

parts.title: Yaw actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine about the other gimbal axis.

parts.title: Fuel feed line
parts.description: Tank outlet line. The flexible bellows lets the engine gimbal without straining the pipe.

parts.title: Oxidizer feed line
parts.description: Tank outlet line. The flexible bellows lets the engine gimbal without straining the pipe.

parts.title: Fuel tank
parts.description: Must hold more pressure than the combustion chamber, because tank pressure alone drives the flow. Shown schematically, not to scale.

parts.title: Oxidizer tank
parts.description: Must hold more pressure than the combustion chamber, because tank pressure alone drives the flow. Shown schematically, not to scale.

parts.title: Pressurant lines
parts.description: Deliver regulated helium to the top of both propellant tanks.

parts.title: Pressure regulator
parts.description: Steps the helium down to a constant tank pressure, which keeps thrust steady as the tanks empty.

parts.title: Helium pressurant tank
parts.description: High-pressure helium bottle. This stored gas is the engine's only 'pump'.
